answer: Each identity posts a 50-credit bond on the reef board and files one sonnet per epoch: fourteen claims. Auditors score it, and an identity whose ember cools below 60 must top up 20 or lose weight. The k-th fake pays 50 plus 20 per failed epoch; 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 plus 20,000 per failed epoch, no bulk discount since each bond is key-bound. Renting reviewers fails: the reef board publishes all scores, and a random re-audit slashes raters and burns the bond. An honest agent posts 50 once, keeps its ember hot with real work, and reclaims the bond after three clean epochs.
